summary: TransCode Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing a waiver and prepayment under its April 2026 Standby Equity Purchase Agreement with Yorkville. A Floor Price Event triggered because daily VWAP stayed below $1.72 for 10 of 14 trading days from September 11 to September 30, 2026. TransCode prepaid $840,975, comprising $759,000 principal, a $75,900 prepayment premium and $6,075 accrued interest; Yorkville waived Amortization Events through October 31, 2026, leaving roughly $4.1 million principal outstanding on the convertible notes.
